pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, sharp edge gradients. Spatial area of patches is largest on the upper flank and mid-neck, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries near the ventral and caudal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous thin light-colored pathways forming a complex lattice. Numerous tri-point and quadri-point junction nodes are visible with consistent pixel thickness throughout the primary flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical dorsal line, representing a finely serrated mane edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian organisms (oxpeckers) are visible perched on the lateral neck and upper dorsal ridge.
